nodes.description: _owner: address of the contract owner, controls onlyOwner restricted functions
_rOwned: mapping of reflection balances per address, core accounting state
_allowances: nested mapping of spender allowances
bots: mapping marking addresses as blocked bots
cooldown: mapping of per-address timestamp gates
_rTotal: total reflection supply, reduced by fees
_tFeeTotal: accumulated token fees
_feeAddr1: tax fee percentage
_feeAddr2: team fee percentage
_feeAddrWallet1: payable recipient of half of collected ETH, also manualswap/manualsend authority
_feeAddrWallet2: payable recipient of half of collected ETH
uniswapV2Router: Uniswap V2 router interface used for swaps and liquidity
uniswapV2Pair: address of the created liquidity pair
tradingOpen: flag gating whether trading is enabled
inSwap: reentrancy-style guard flag set during swap processing
swapEnabled: flag controlling automatic fee swapping
cooldownEnabled: flag controlling per-address trade cooldown
_maxTxAmount: maximum transaction amount enforced when cooldown is enabled
_isExcludedFromFee: mapping of addresses exempt from fees and limits
constructor: sets owner, fee wallets, initial reflection balance and fee exclusions
transfer: public ERC20 transfer entrypoint routing through _transfer
transferFrom: public allowance-based transfer entrypoint
_approve: private helper writing _allowances
_transfer: private core transfer logic with bot checks, cooldown, max tx limit and auto ETH swap
swapTokensForEth: private function swapping contract tokens for ETH via the router under lockTheSwap
sendETHToFee: private function splitting ETH between the two fee wallets
openTrading: owner-only initialization of router, pair, liquidity and trading flags
setBots: owner-only bulk marking of addresses as bots
removeStrictTxLimit: owner-only restore of the max transaction amount
delBot: owner-only removal of an address from the bot list
_tokenTransfer: private dispatcher to _transferStandard
_transferStandard: private routine updating reflection balances, team cut and fees
_takeTeam: private routine crediting the team token share to the contract
_reflectFee: private routine reducing _rTotal and accumulating _tFeeTotal
manualswap: fee wallet gated manual swap of contract token balance
manualsend: fee wallet gated manual distribution of contract ETH
_getValues: private computation of reflection amounts, fees and team cut
_getTValues: private pure computation of token fee/team/transfer amounts
_getRValues: private pure computation of reflection amounts
_getRate: private computation of the reflection rate
_getCurrentSupply: private supply snapshot used by _getRate
renounceOwnership: owner-only function setting _owner to zero
setCooldownEnabled: owner-only toggle of the cooldown feature
tokenFromReflection: private conversion of reflection amounts to token amounts
balanceOf: public view returning token balance derived from _rOwned
msg.sender: externally controlled caller identity used for ownership, auth and transfer initiation
block.timestamp: miner-influenced time value used for cooldown and swap deadlines
external call to uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens
external ETH transfer to _feeAddrWallet1
external ETH transfer to _feeAddrWallet2
external call to uniswapV2Router.addLiquidityETH with contract ETH balance
external call to Uniswap V2 factory createPair
external call approving max allowance on the created pair token
recipient parameter of transfer
amount parameter of transfer
from parameter of _transfer
to parameter of _transfer
amount parameter of _transfer
tokenAmount parameter of swapTokensForEth
amount parameter of sendETHToFee
bots_ array parameter of setBots
notbot address parameter of delBot
onoff boolean parameter of setCooldownEnabled
tAmount parameter of _transferStandard
local contractTokenBalance in _transfer used for auto swap
local contractETHBalance in _transfer used for fee distribution
local swap path array in swapTokensForEth
local currentRate holding the reflection rate
local tFee token fee amount computed in _getTValues
local tTeam token team amount computed in _getTValues
local rAmount reflection amount computed in _getRValues

edges.reason: transfer uses _msgSender() as the implicit sender argument
_approve is invoked with _msgSender() as owner
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as spender for allowance check
constructor assigns _owner from _msgSender()
manualswap gates execution on _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1
manualsend gates execution on _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1
renounceOwnership authorization depends on _msgSender() via onlyOwner
cooldown[to] is written as block.timestamp + 17 seconds, making it timestamp dependent
_transfer compares cooldown[to] against block.timestamp to gate trades
openTrading passes block.timestamp as the liquidity deadline and enables the cooldown
block.timestamp is supplied as the swap deadline parameter
transfer forwards sender, recipient and amount into _transfer
transferFrom forwards sender, recipient and amount into _transfer
transferFrom reads and reduces _allowances
_approve writes the _allowances mapping
balanceOf converts reflection balance using tokenFromReflection
tokenFromReflection receives _rOwned[account] as input
_transfer delegates the actual balance mutation to _tokenTransfer
_tokenTransfer routes to _transferStandard
_transferStandard obtains amounts from _getValues
_transferStandard debits sender and credits recipient in _rOwned
_transferStandard forwards the team cut to _takeTeam
_transferStandard forwards fee values to _reflectFee
_takeTeam credits _rOwned of the contract with the team reflection amount
_takeTeam derives rTeam using _getRate
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal by the reflection fee
_reflectFee increases _tFeeTotal by the token fee
_getValues reads _feeAddr1 as the tax fee
_getValues reads _feeAddr2 as the team fee
_getValues calls _getTValues
_getValues calls _getRValues
_getValues obtains the current rate from _getRate
_getRate divides rSupply by tSupply from _getCurrentSupply
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotal for the supply snapshot
_transfer consults _isExcludedFromFee before applying limits and fees
_transfer enforces the _maxTxAmount limit on pair buys
_transfer reads cooldownEnabled to decide whether the cooldown applies
_transfer reads inSwap to prevent nested swap processing
_transfer reads swapEnabled before triggering the automatic swap
_transfer reverts when either party is recorded in bots
_transfer invokes swapTokensForEth on the collected contract balance
_transfer invokes sendETHToFee on the accumulated contract ETH
swapTokensForEth performs the router swap external call
swapTokensForEth approves the router through _approve before swapping
swapTokensForEth calls the stored uniswapV2Router
openTrading calls addLiquidityETH with the contract ETH balance
openTrading calls factory createPair
openTrading approves the maximum allowance on the pair token
openTrading stores the Uniswap V2 router address
openTrading stores the created pair address
openTrading enables swaps by setting swapEnabled
openTrading enables the cooldown by setting cooldownEnabled
openTrading sets tradingOpen to true
openTrading sets the initial _maxTxAmount
openTrading approves the router through _approve
setBots writes true entries into the bots mapping
removeStrictTxLimit raises _maxTxAmount to the full total supply
delBot clears the bots mapping entry for an address
setCooldownEnabled toggles the cooldownEnabled flag
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth with the contract token balance
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance
setBots is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier checking _owner
removeStrictTxLimit is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier checking _owner
delBot is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier checking _owner
setCooldownEnabled is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier checking _owner
openTrading is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier checking _owner
renounceOwnership is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier checking _owner
the router swap external call executes inside _transfer before _tokenTransfer mutates balances, allowing reentrant entry if the token balance is nonzero
native ETH transfer to _feeAddrWallet1 is an external call with no reentrancy guard around it
native ETH transfer to _feeAddrWallet2 is an external call with no reentrancy guard around it

normalization_plan.reason: the recipient parameter only feeds the transfer entrypoint and carries no independent security semantics
the amount parameter is consumed directly by transfer and should be folded into it
the from parameter is only meaningful as an input to _transfer's checks and accounting
the to parameter is only meaningful within _transfer's cooldown, bot and swap logic
the amount parameter gates cooldown and max transaction checks inside _transfer
tokenAmount is only used to size the swap performed by swapTokensForEth
the amount parameter is only split and forwarded to the fee wallets by sendETHToFee
the bots array is only iterated to write the bots mapping inside setBots
the notbot address is only used to clear the bots mapping entry in delBot
the boolean parameter only toggles cooldownEnabled and has no independent behavior
tAmount is the sole input driving the reflection math in _transferStandard
the local balance snapshot is only used to decide and size the automatic swap in _transfer
the local ETH balance is only used to conditionally trigger fee distribution in _transfer
the swap path array is a temporary construction only used for the router call in swapTokensForEth
currentRate is the return value of _getRate and should be normalized into that function
tFee is a derived intermediate computed and returned by _getTValues
tTeam is a derived intermediate computed and returned by _getTValues
rAmount is a derived intermediate computed and returned by _getRValues
